description: Envelope generator, turning a gate into a four-stage control voltage running 0-10V

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to rise to 10V while the gate is high, from 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from 10V to the sustain level, from 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds at for as long as the gate stays high
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall to 0V once the gate goes low, from 1ms to 10 seconds
Scales the ATT input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the DEC input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the SUS input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Scales the REL input from -100% to 100%, so the modulation can be made shallow or reversed
Holding this runs the envelope as though a gate were high, and letting go starts the release

inputs.text: Moves the attack time by an amount set by the ATT knob
Moves the decay time by an amount set by the DEC knob
Moves the sustain level by an amount set by the SUS knob
Moves the release time by an amount set by the REL knob
A high voltage runs the attack and decay stages and holds at the sustain level; going low starts the release
A trigger sends the envelope back to its attack stage without the gate going low, which gives each note of a legato phrase its own attack
